wire.t: First league trade since Sept. 17: TotesMagoat sent Kaleb Johnson and his 2029 3rd to BeatULikeABoss for BeatULikeABoss's 2029 2nd. BeatULikeABoss also got his own 2029 5th back. Johnson has 23.20 points this season, all of them on Lemon Squeezy's bench, and is already in Young Love Hunters' Week 10 lineup.

Josh Jacobs is having surgery on a fractured ring finger, with reports ranging from out indefinitely to a maximum of three weeks. Kaleb Johnson ran 14 times for 68 yards and a touchdown in Week 9, and MarShawn Lloyd (Bill_Buttlicker) is reported good to go for Sunday against the Vikings. BertDirty owns Jacobs.

TotesMagoat added David Njoku and the Chargers defense Wednesday night. Njoku is on IR with a fibula injury and was designated to return on Nov. 4, which opened his 21-day practice window. Also Wednesday: BeatULikeABoss dropped the Commanders defense, and Bill_Buttlicker claimed Colts receiver Ashton Dulin and dropped Elijah Mitchell (13.30 points in two weeks on the roster).

The Ravens traded for Jacoby Brissett and he's expected to start Monday night against the Chargers with Lamar Jackson on IR. Bill_Buttlicker owns Brissett (111.16 points this season) as the backup to Patrick Mahomes. RedDevil904 owns Jackson (84.08 points).

The Vikings got Kirk Cousins from the Raiders for a 2027 third at the deadline, and he's likely to start soon if not right away. RedDevil904 owns Cousins (177.30 points). ChuckJ10 owns Kyler Murray, who is week-to-week with a hamstring strain.
Malik Willis went to IR with a groin injury and Kyle McCord is in line for his first NFL start Sunday at Indianapolis. BeatULikeABoss owns Willis and claimed McCord for $145 of FAAB on Tuesday night.
Puka Nacua has MCL and PCL sprains plus turf toe, and Sean McVay said he'll be out at least a month. superdog91 owns Nacua, who has 175.60 points this season.
Gardner Minshew is feared to have a torn UCL and rookie Carson Beck is expected to start for Arizona. RobMeyers has Beck on his taxi squad.

stories.title: TotesMagoat sells Kaleb Johnson the week Josh Jacobs goes under the knife
stories.dek: Lemon Squeezy (8‑1) flips a bench back and a 2029 3rd for Young Love Hunters' 2029 2nd. It's the first league trade in almost two months.
body: The trade drought is over. TotesMagoat sent Kaleb Johnson and Lemon Squeezy's 2029 3rd to BeatULikeABoss for Young Love Hunters' 2029 2nd, and BeatULikeABoss got his own 2029 5th back in the deal. It's the first trade in this league since Sept. 17. Johnson is 23 and scored 23.20 points in nine weeks for Lemon Squeezy, every one of them on the bench, 12.80 of them in Week 9.

Here's why it's interesting: Josh Jacobs is getting surgery on a fractured ring finger, and the reports range from out indefinitely to a maximum of three weeks. Johnson ran 14 times for 68 yards and a touchdown against the Patriots once Jacobs went down. MarShawn Lloyd (Bill_Buttlicker, yes, me) is reported good to go for Sunday against the Vikings, so it's not a clean lead job. BeatULikeABoss didn't wait to find out. Johnson is already in Young Love Hunters' Week 10 lineup against 50 Shades of Rae, who is still a 99% favorite.

The dynasty math: TotesMagoat now owns 2029 2nds from himself and BeatULikeABoss, still has six firsts across the next three drafts, and the team that's 1-8 is the one most likely to make that 2nd an early one. He sold a guy who never cracked his lineup for a better pick in a year when Young Love Hunters could still be bad. BeatULikeABoss gets a 23-year-old back with a possible starting role for a few weeks and still holds eight 2027 picks in the first three rounds. Rich get richer, rebuild gets a running back. Nobody got robbed, which is honestly a disappointment for this website.

TotesMagoat wasn't done. He picked up David Njoku, who's on IR with a fibula injury but was designated to return on Nov. 4, and the Chargers defense. And I claimed Ashton Dulin and dropped Elijah Mitchell, because the Colts just traded Josh Downs and somebody has to catch passes in Indianapolis.

stories.title: The NFL trade deadline just rewrote three quarterback rooms in this league
stories.dek: Jacoby Brissett is a Raven, Kirk Cousins is a Viking again, and Kyle McCord cost $145.
body: The Ravens traded for Jacoby Brissett with Lamar Jackson on IR, and Brissett is expected to start Monday night against the Chargers. Bill_Buttlicker owns him as the backup to Patrick Mahomes, who is day-to-day with an elbow strain and expected to play at Atlanta. So the commissioner's QB2 is now an actual NFL starter. I'd like to say that was the plan. It was not the plan. RedDevil904 owns Jackson (84.08 points) and gets nothing out of this except a reason to start Kirk Cousins.

Speaking of Cousins: the Vikings sent the Raiders a 2027 third for him at the deadline, and he's likely to start soon if not right away. RedDevil904 has him at 177.30 points this season, and Trevor Have I Ever is 5-4 with no 2027 first, second or third. Cousins is 38. All-In doesn't mean what it used to. ChuckJ10 owns Kyler Murray, who is week-to-week with a hamstring strain, so the Vikings job he'd come back to now has Cousins in it.

In Miami, Malik Willis went to IR and Kyle McCord gets his first NFL start Sunday at Indianapolis. BeatULikeABoss owns Willis and paid $145 of FAAB Tuesday night for McCord. Also moved at the deadline: Keenan Allen (TotesMagoat) to the 49ers and Josh Downs (G8rDuc) to the Chiefs. Week 10 lines haven't moved: Lemon Squeezy 93%, 50 Shades of Rae 99%, Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 95%, Mean Machine 87%, Trevor Have I Ever 74% and Picken Weiners 71%.

stories.title: 50 Shades of Rae loses Puka Nacua for at least a month, and Mean Machine loses Josh Jacobs
stories.dek: superdog91 is still 7‑2 and a 99% favorite. BertDirty is 4‑5 and needs a running back.
body: Puka Nacua has MCL and PCL sprains and turf toe, and Sean McVay said he'll be out at least a month. With the Rams' Week 11 bye, he can't be back before Week 15. That's 175.60 points off superdog91's roster, the second-most of any of his receivers behind Christian Watson (181.90). 50 Shades of Rae is still 7-2 with Watson, Bijan Robinson (182.00) and Bucky Irving (161.10), and plays Young Love Hunters this week as a 99% favorite.

Josh Jacobs has a fractured finger, needs surgery and could miss up to three weeks. BertDirty had him for 20.10 and 23.20 in Weeks 7 and 8 and 0.50 in Week 9. Mean Machine is 4-5 with the fourth-most points per game (136.94) and still has Kyren Williams (159.10) and Quinshon Judkins (92.10). It's an 87% favorite over Prepetente is the GOAT!, which is missing Rhamondre Stevenson.

The Packers backs on league rosters are Kaleb Johnson (traded Wednesday from TotesMagoat to BeatULikeABoss, 12.80 in Week 9) and MarShawn Lloyd (Bill_Buttlicker), who is reported good to go this week after missing Week 9 with a knee injury. Patrick Mahomes is day-to-day with an elbow strain, Justin Herbert's X-rays were negative and Ladd McConkey is day-to-day with back spasms.

stories.title: Prepetente is the GOAT! beats Hurts So Good by 0.48, and 50 Shades of Rae drops 203.26
stories.dek: The closest game of the year, the biggest blowout of the year (+137.60), and a winless team that finally isn't.
body: Prepetente is the GOAT! 95.78, Hurts So Good 95.30. That's a 0.48-point game, the closest of 2026 (the old mark was 0.94 in Week 3). Brock Purdy gave Marco_Polo 25.28 at quarterback, and he still left Kayshon Boutte's 29.50 on the bench. MakeItRains left Darren Waller's 23.00 on the pine while Greg Dulcich started at FLEX for 3.40. Either of those moves flips a game decided by less than a point, and one of them did flip it.

50 Shades of Rae hung 203.26 on Hanging with Hernandez, who scored 65.66, the lowest score of the week. The 137.60-point margin is the biggest of the season (the old mark was 113.42 in Week 7). Puka Nacua had 35.00, Christian Watson 31.10, Bucky Irving 28.50 and Bijan Robinson 26.70 for superdog91, who is 7-2 and second in points.

Elsewhere: Lemon Squeezy beat Picken Weiners 139.06 to 115.58 and is 8-1, Ceedees ships coming! 🏆 beat Trevor Have I Ever 165.80 to 137.98 on Kenneth Walker III (36.30) and CeeDee Lamb (35.50), Mean Machine beat Chubb So Big I Waddle 119.24 to 97.06 behind Joe Burrow's 31.54, and Young Love Hunters got its first win. TotesMagoat's 155.88 bench total takes the Week 9 bench payout.

rumors.t: TotesMagoat reportedly accepted the Kaleb Johnson trade from inside a vault filled entirely with draft picks, Scrooge McDuck style. He has asked the league office whether a 2029 2nd can be framed. The league office does not frame things.
BeatULikeABoss's cat has reportedly been promoted to general manager after the Kaleb Johnson trade, and is already asking about a 2031 first. The 2031 draft does not exist yet. The cat does not care.

BeatULikeABoss's $145 bid on Kyle McCord was reportedly entered by his cat walking across the keypad. The cat has also placed a $1 bid on the entire Dolphins practice squad and is expected to win most of it.
RedDevil904 has reportedly asked Sleeper to rename Trevor Have I Ever to 'Kirk Have I Ever' and offered a 2027 third-round pick for the change. He does not own a 2027 third-round pick.
Bill_Buttlicker has reportedly scheduled a commissioner's hearing on whether Jacoby Brissett becoming a starter counts as 'a plan.' The commissioner presided and ruled that it was always the plan.
G8rDuc's phone has reportedly been confiscated by the league office after it kept moving J.J. McCarthy into the lineup on its own. The phone denies everything.
MakeItRains is reportedly petitioning to amend the bylaws so Darren Waller is automatically locked into the FLEX. The bylaws are written on a napkin, and somebody used the napkin.
superdog91 has reportedly asked whether the 203.26 from Week 9 can roll over into Week 10 like unused cell phone minutes. The league office said no, then checked whether it actually could.

trades.why: Puka Nacua is out at least a month and superdog91 is 7-2 and chasing a fourth title. Higgins (27) has 161.80 points. RobMeyers is 3-6 with one of the older cores in the league, and BeatULikeABoss's second could be the first pick of round two.
Josh Jacobs could miss up to three weeks. Warren (28) has 143.80 points and G8rDuc is 2-7 with no 2027 picks, so a pick for a 28-year-old running back is the right direction.
Jalen Hurts is on IR. Nix is 26 with 135.80 points and he's the third quarterback on a roster with Jared Goff and Matthew Stafford. Buccaneer51 gets a pick for the one he can't start.

Jake Ferguson is out multiple weeks and ChuckJ10 needs a tight end now. Kelce has 101.30 points and is 37. G8rDuc gets his own third back for a player who won't be on the next good Hanging with Hernandez team.
BeatULikeABoss already has Jordan Love and just paid $145 for Kyle McCord, and now sends the first that could be the 1.01 for a 38-year-old quarterback. In a dynasty league. On a 1-8 team.
Self-roast: Bill_Buttlicker's backup quarterback just became the Ravens' starter by accident, so naturally he sends a first for a second backup with zero career snaps. Fire me.
BertDirty sends a 22-year-old receiver with 138.30 points to the guy who already owns six firsts, for a 34-year-old with 81.10 points who just changed teams. The empire grows.

Bill_Buttlicker's backup quarterback, Jacoby Brissett, is now the Ravens' starter. Good for you, commish. You didn't plan it, but you'll take credit for it.

columns.title: KIRK COUSINS IS 38 AND HE'S A VIKING AGAIN!

columns.title: TotesMagoat sold a guy he never played. That's how you stay 8‑1
columns.dek: Kaleb Johnson started zero games for Lemon Squeezy. Now he's a 2029 2nd.
body: Kaleb Johnson was on Lemon Squeezy's roster for nine weeks and started zero times. 23.20 points, all bench. Then Josh Jacobs breaks a finger, Johnson gets 14 carries and a touchdown, and TotesMagoat sells him the same week. That's not luck. That's knowing what you have.

BeatULikeABoss, I don't hate it. You're 1-8, he's 23, and you put him in the lineup right away. But you paid with your own 2029 2nd, and your team has been bad enough this year that somebody's going to circle that pick. Win some games so it's a late one. That's the whole job now.

columns.title: Holden McGroin's Three Rules For Trade Deadline Week
columns.dek: The NFL deadline is over. Ours is Week 13. I have a system.
body: 1. The market price for a backup quarterback is $145. BeatULikeABoss set it Tuesday night with Kyle McCord. That means every backup quarterback in the league is worth $145, and if you have $146 you should bid it on Brady Cook just to be safe.

2. Buy players the day after they change teams. Josh Downs went to the Chiefs and Keenan Allen went to the 49ers. New teams mean new playbooks, and new playbooks mean nobody has figured out how to stop them yet. Allen is 34, which means he's seen 34 playbooks.
3. Bench your starter for the guy who hasn't played. Jacoby Brissett scored 0.00 for Bill_Buttlicker in Week 9 and 3.46 in Week 8. That's not a slump. That's a man saving his points for Monday night.

columns.title: 55% of Kaleb Johnson's season came in one week, so my model says he's 55% sold
columns.dek: 23.20 points, nine weeks, zero starts, one trade.
body: Kaleb Johnson scored 12.80 of his 23.20 points in Week 9. That's 55.2% of his season in 11.1% of the weeks, which my 'Concentration Coefficient' rates as 5.0, the highest number I've ever made up. He also scored -0.20 in Week 6, which means at one point he owed Lemon Squeezy points.

TotesMagoat now owns two 2029 2nds and six firsts across the next three drafts. Young Love Hunters is 1-8 with 633.52 points, or 70.39 per game, which my model converts to a 'Pick Pedigree Score' of 1-8. That's just the record again. I'm told the pick is going to be good, and so is my spreadsheet.

facts: TotesMagoat (4) and superdog91 (3) have won all seven titles since 2019. They've met in the final four times.
ChuckJ10 went 13-1 in 2025 and didn't make the final. TotesMagoat went 13-1 in 2023 and lost it. The best record has won it three times in seven years.

th.note: Every trade in Sleeper history, 2019 through 2025, graded by what each side actually got. Value = PPR fantasy points each player scored from the day of the trade through Week 8 of 2026. Picks count the player who was actually drafted with that pick, from his rookie year on. It measures production, not trade value today: a 2025 rookie hasn't had time to catch up to a five-year vet.
th.ledgerNote: Graded trades only. Net = points received minus points sent, added up across every trade. Former managers in italics.

top.t: The Trade That Built an Empire
top.take: In January 2020, superdog91 sent the picks that became Justin Jefferson and Justin Herbert to TotesMagoat for Devin Singletary and a third. Jefferson and Herbert have scored 3,708.3 points since. TotesMagoat has four titles. superdog91 has three, which is impressive given he handed his rival the keys.

Bill_Buttlicker got Patrick Mahomes and the pick that became Chuba Hubbard. G8rDuc got Drew Brees, who retired after the season, and the Michael Carter pick. The scoreboard says 2,853.1 to 529.9. G8rDuc is 22-80 all time, and this is part of why.

ChuckJ10 bought Michael Thomas in November 2020 and paid with Christian Kirk plus his 2021 and 2022 firsts. Thomas gave him 220.1 points. The 2022 first became Chris Olave. ChuckJ10 has never made a final, and trades like this are a big reason why.

superdog91 got Kenny Gainwell and the picks that became George Pickens (#16) and Kyren Williams, a fourth-rounder at #40, all for Devin Singletary. Kyren alone has 970.9 points. RedDevil904 still has never made the playoffs.

RedDevil904 sent five picks to Bill_Buttlicker for Christian McCaffrey. Those picks became Javonte Williams, Elijah Moore, Kenneth Walker III, Malik Willis and Roschon Johnson. CMC gave RedDevil904 1,482.6 points. The picks have given 2,855.7.

TotesMagoat got Amon-Ra St. Brown from Besch42 for Mecole Hardman Jr. and Quintez Cephus. St. Brown has 1,598.9 points since. Four months later, Besch42 lost the 2021 final to TotesMagoat. He'd handed him the WR1 himself.

Self-roast time. Bill_Buttlicker traded the picks that became DeVonta Smith (#11) and Kenny Gainwell to RedDevil904 for Miles Sanders. Sanders: 524.5. Smith and Gainwell: 1,782.6. The man who runs this website did that.

top.t: Pollard for a Pick That Missed
top.take: superdog91 sent Tony Pollard to ChuckJ10 for a 2021 second that became Terrace Marshall. Pollard has 1,255.7 points since. Marshall has 155.8.
